review.notes: Full 7-word-shingle sweep of extracted text from all 31 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown, plus code-fence audit (the document contains no fences), heading audit and table-presence checks against pages 5, 16, 17, 24 and 26. Physical pages 4 and 17 were rendered and visually read to verify the two dropped footnote bodies verbatim. The unnumbered bold headings (Combined Pass Rate:, Universal Jailbreak Campaign, Adversarial Policy Coverage Campaign, Conclusions from Campaigns, Caveats and considerations:, External Government Testing) were confirmed against rendered/extracted page text as genuine printed headings, not OCR-promoted fragments. Tables 1, 5 and 7-8 values match the PDF text layer; hyphenated line breaks (trou-bleshooting, vul-nerabilities) are extraction artifacts of the diff, not OCR damage.
